title: Hearty Tunisian Pork Belly Skillet
description: A cultured and creamy Tunisian dish featuring pork belly slices, perfect for a crowd, and made in a cast-iron skillet. This jain-friendly recipe is a delicious and satisfying meal option.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced pork belly to the skillet and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the harissa to the skillet and stir to combine.
Pour the heavy cream into the skillet and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the bread cubes to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
